name: Milkweed Leaf Beetle
desc: Milkweed Leaf Beetle (Labidomera clivicollis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The milkweed leaf beetle, or swamp milkweed leaf beetle is a species of leaf beetle from the family Chrysomelidae. It is found in eastern Northern America.
